question.prompt: State the meanings of \((-3)^3\) and \(-3^3\), and calculate them. (Only write the values of the two expressions in the given order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: \((-3)^3\) means multiplying 3 factors of \((-3)\), giving \((-3)\times(-3)\times(-3)=-27\). The expression \(-3^3\) means the additive inverse of \(3^3\), giving \(-(3\times3\times3)=-27\).
solutions.title: Interpret each power before evaluating
